name: Native Debug & Memory Inspector
description: Provides expert-grade reverse engineering and diagnostic capabilities including process attachment, dynamic library injection, remote export method invocation, handle release, virtual/DMA memory read/write, and pattern scanning.

AttachProcess.description: Attach to target application process with support for dynamic library injection and initialization payload

CallMethod.description: Invoke specified exported function from a loaded module or target process and retrieve execution results

CloseHandle.description: Close and release opened system resource handles to ensure stability and resolve file locks

ReadMemory.description: Read data from target process memory addresses with multi-level pointer offsets and varied type formats

SearchMemory.description: Scan and locate specific byte patterns (AOB) with wildcard and relative addressing support

WriteMemory.description: Write data to target process memory addresses with optional automatic page unprotection
